description: This header file defines an interface class 'IFactories' in the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The class provides methods for creating and accessing various web-related proxy objects such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC, which are used elsewhere in the project for web request handling and communication. It also includes static methods for singleton access and availability checks. The file includes licensing information and a dependency on 'Module.h'.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface for factory methods that produce web-related proxy objects used in request handling and JSONRPC communication in the framework.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Static method to assign an instance of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to get the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Static method to check if the factory instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::Request proxy object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::Response proxy object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::FileBody proxy object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message> proxy object.
